scenes.notes: REVEAL: Cut below: three Orca glide beneath the kayak's shadow (first full reveal); red Headline THEY'RE DECIDING SOMETHING on 'deciding' | VO: That quiet is a pod of orcas, deciding something about you.

INFO: GreatWhite enters left beside a small YOU; Tag ~60-70 BITES / YEAR (ISAF) on 'sixty' | VO: Sharks bite around sixty to seventy people a year, unprovoked. The orca, the one called killer, sits on zero.
INFO: Orca slides in, Tag KILLER WHALE stamps across it, Stat 0 pops on 'zero' | VO: Sharks bite around sixty to seventy people a year, unprovoked. The orca, the one called killer, sits on zero.

props.text:
WHY HAS IT
NEVER PICKED YOU?

scenes.notes: PUNCH: Master question on a hard black frame, white with red YOU, held through the 1 s pause | VO: So why has an animal built for killing never picked you?

scenes.notes: CALLBACK: Hook hull frame, silent: Tag LOOKING; on 'chatty' the rings return softly with Tag DECIDED | VO: So the quiet under your kayak was a check, silent while they look and chatty once they've decided.
PUNCH: Green stamp THEY CHECKED. YOU WEREN'T FOOD. over the YOU icon (calls back THEY CHECK FIRST) | VO: They checked, and you weren't food.
CARD: The hook's WILD HUMAN KILLS: 0 card returns; IN THE WILD underlines in red on 'wild' | VO: Which leaves three words from the start: in the wild.

INFO: Side-view tank cross-section (grey walls, flat water); one Orca swims back and forth, scaleX flips at each wall | VO: Every human death ever linked to an orca happened in a marine park, with animals taken from the sea or born in tanks. There have been four.

INFO: Stat 4 in red, label HUMAN DEATHS · ALL IN CAPTIVITY (one sober line, no names) | VO: Every human death ever linked to an orca happened in a marine park, with animals taken from the sea or born in tanks. There have been four.
